accepted_boundaries: raw fast > 0 proves a fast request was accepted; it is not cache hit rate
Solo fast = 0 is expected because the candidate must belong to a different bank
scientific negative results do not trigger automatic repeats
if a positive preliminary benefit exists, evaluate with S/N paired fresh boots in alternating order
do not remove the read admission guard without replacing its dependency protection
diagnostic_interface_not_yet_accepted: probe conservation must include outstanding probes at window OPEN as well as CLOSE; a legitimate partial window must not be labeled a protocol error
guard delay taps must refer to an actually queued bank read with relevant controller selection conditions; upstream AR_VALID alone does not prove the guard delayed that request
opportunity counts are cycle counts, not distinct requests or cache hit rate
